## Decisions
- Removed ShippedBar from What Now — bare numbers with no context were confusing
- Menu bar deprecated — npx-first model doesn't fit macOS native app distribution
- `extras` catch-all on PortfolioAnalysis — unknown AI fields render as "More from AI"
- Single git log call for daily commits (efficient) instead of 365 individual calls
- Charts side-by-side (grid layout) not stacked full-width
- Focus Goals removed from What Now — redundant with AI+GitHub
- "Since Last Visit" removed from What Now and Analytics — low value

## Notes
- Dev server: `pnpm dev -- --port 3210` starts API on that port + Vite on 5173. Vite proxies `/api` to the API server.
- API port is dynamic unless `--port` is specified. The `SIDEQUESTS_API_PORT` env var also works.
- The `mergeAllProjectsLean()` variant skips `metaJson` — only use it for endpoints that don't need metadata. The stats endpoint correctly uses full `mergeAllProjects()`.
- `buildMergedView` constructs `p.meta` from `scan.metaJson` + `llm.extrasJson`. If `scan.metaJson` is stale (pre-dailyCommitCounts), `p.meta.dailyCommitCounts` will be undefined.
- Can't view screenshots with this model — use `agent-browser snapshot` (accessibility tree) instead.
